response.sql:
WITH filtered_scans AS (
  SELECT 
    s.zoneref,
    s.gbsize,
    s.pressratio,
    s.spanmin,
    si.typesite
  FROM scans s
  INNER JOIN sites si ON s.zoneref = si.zoneregistry
  WHERE s.chronotag >= '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274'
    AND s.chronotag <= '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797'
),
group_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    zoneref,
    typesite,
    AVG(pressratio) as avg_pressratio,
    AVG(gbsize / NULLIF(spanmin, 0)) as avg_size_per_min
  FROM filtered_scans
  GROUP BY zoneref, typesite
)
SELECT 
  AVG(avg_pressratio) as overall_avg_pressratio,
  AVG(avg_size_per_min) as overall_avg_size_per_min
FROM group_averages;

assumptions.assumption: chronotag is stored as ISO-format timestamp text (e.g., '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274') comparable via string comparison. The documentation mentions possible numeric Excel serial date storage, but the request explicitly uses ISO format strings for comparison.

alternatives.interpretation: If chronotag is stored as numeric Excel serial dates, convert the provided ISO timestamps to their Excel serial equivalents (45478.495833 for 2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274 and 45658.827298 for 2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797) and use numeric comparison.
